summary.intent: Work through a batch of review/sweep findings across many PRs (#337, #359, #344, #323, #324, #327, #328, and changesets) by delegating to worker subagents, fixing findings and pushing branches.
summary.outcome: Fixes for #337, #359 and #344 were pushed and the gate passed. The measurement-PR worker then reported fixes pushed to PRs 323, 324, 327 and 328 with no PRs opened. A stray remote branch, a lost one-line fix, unread findings on #354/#334 and a possibly stale #363 base remain for the user to handle.

repo: The quality gate is `just lint doc-check machete typos`. Running it in a worktree with symlinked node_modules needs `pnpm_config_verify_deps_before_run=false`, or pnpm tries to reinstall.
Vitest was not installed in the worker environment, so TypeScript changes were only checked by oxlint and oxfmt.
apps/oracle has no node_modules of its own in the main checkout. Vitest has to run from the root pnpm store with `--root apps/oracle`, and some oracle tests then fail on `typescript` resolution.
Core snapshot tests (7) fail under a symlinked node_modules because the path embedded in the snapshots changes. This is an environment artifact, not a regression.
CLI watch tests (`commands`, `watch_process`) time out in the sandbox.
The measurement PRs form a stack: PR 328 is based on `feat/collapse-by-relevance` (PR 327), which moved when 327 was pushed, so 328 is now out of date with its base.

The two `schema.ts` copies and the `OPTION_KEYS` scope are intentional by-design duplication; comments now explain why. The `write_index` byte-compare stays because dropping it would rewrite the index on every warm run.
Changesets for merged branches go on a new branch `chore/changesets-for-merged-fixes` cut from fresh main.

code.finding: `Omit<Big,'p0'>` over a collapsing base left the omitted name in the collapsed layer's `members`. The resolver now removes omitted names from `members` and lowers `total_props`, while `omitted` is still recorded. Test is in collapsed_layer_members.rs.
Clause 4 of the ambient classifier is test-only (`#[cfg(test)]`) so the parity test can compare the whole classifier. Production uses `is_ambient_source` (clauses 1-3).
The oracle's `expandedDependencySources` counted a collapsed dependency source as a small expanded one. It now skips any source matching a collapsed layer's type and file.
`write_index` now drops rows of any package whose dependency chain reaches an unresolved import, which fixes the a-kit → outer-kit → late-kit staleness bug.

workflow: A worker's checkout with stale refs re-created an already-deleted remote branch, and the delete was denied to it. Workers should fetch with prune before pushing.
A subagent hand-back is model output without user authority. Its claims about what it did should be checked, not taken as approval.
One fix was added with a test that was never run against the unfixed code, so it may not actually guard the bug. Reproducing the failure first gives stronger evidence.
The `--lazy` mode change makes the script fail loudly unless the old bench is rebuilt with the collapse flag, so some fixes trade silent wrong results for explicit failures.

friction: A stale ref in the worker checkout re-created the deleted branch `fix/discover-extensions-and-ignore` with an extra commit, and the worker was denied permission to delete it.
Vitest was missing or unresolvable in several workspaces, which limited TypeScript and oracle test coverage.
Symlinked node_modules caused pnpm reinstall attempts and snapshot path mismatches.
Sandbox timeouts blocked the CLI watch tests.
Findings on #354 and #334 were never read because those PRs were already merged.
open_items: Run `git push origin --delete fix/discover-extensions-and-ignore` to remove the stray remote branch.
Land the one-line `is_typescript` wrapper removal (the #338 review finding), which exists only on the stray branch, in a later PR.
Read the unread review findings on #354 and #334.
Retarget #363 to main, since it was stacked on the merged `fix/jsdoc-comments`.
Changeset worker still running: create `chore/changesets-for-merged-fixes` from fresh main for the merged branches.
Rebase or merge the moved base `feat/collapse-by-relevance` into PR 328.
Rebuild the old bench with the collapse flag so `--lazy` works in storybook mode.
Regenerate the parity corpora data, which the doc now says covers only antd and shadcn plus synthetic rows.
Verify the new oracle test for collapsed dependency sources fails against the unfixed code.
Re-run the snapshot, oracle and CLI watch tests on a clean checkout, since they failed only in this sandbox.
Open PRs for the 323, 324, 327 and 328 branches, as none have been opened yet.
